name: AlphaGenome merged splicing score, distilled model, Atlas precomputed (AlphaGenome Atlas v1)
description: AlphaGenome splice site score plus splice site usage score plus one fifth of the splice junction score, each the maximum over all positions and genes, from the distilled model with 1 Mb context.

attributes.parameters: S_splicing = S_sites + S_usage + S_junctions / 5, each component the maximum over all coordinates and genes. Scorers (Table S1): GeneMaskSplicingScorer requested_output=SPLICE_SITES, width=None; GeneMaskSplicingScorer requested_output=SPLICE_SITE_USAGE, width=None (282 biosamples, 367 tracks); SpliceJunctionScorer (282 biosamples, 367 tracks); stranded scorers merged across strands. Raw scores, no quantile transform. GRCh38, GENCODE v46. Genome tiled into 128 bp windows; each window scored with a 1 Mb input centred on the window, so the variant lies within 64 bp of the centre (not centred on the variant); reference prediction cached per window.
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Genome-wide inference of AlphaGenome', 'Sliding Window Approach', 'Input Features' item 1 (pages 18 to 22); Table S1 (page 69)
